  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;

            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
              const LOG = '[ZephrInit]'

              // Zephr resolves each feature against EVERY element matching its
              // target class, so duplicate targets get the feature HTML injected
              // more than once (duplicate DOM, duplicate ids, and a SyntaxError
              // from the feature's own top-level const declarations re-running).
              //
              // Our login-modal target is legitimately emitted from more than one
              // place - page templates, the Viafoura commenting embed, module
              // templates - so collapse duplicates to a single element here,
              // immediately before Zephr scans the page.
              const ZEPHR_SINGLETON_TARGETS = ['Zephr-mod']

              const dedupeZephrTargets = () => {
                ZEPHR_SINGLETON_TARGETS.forEach((cls) => {
                  const matches = document.querySelectorAll('.Zephr.' + cls)
                  if (matches.length < 2) return

                  console.warn(
                    `${LOG} found ${matches.length} .${cls} targets; keeping the first`
                  )

                  for (let i = 1; i < matches.length; i++) {
                    // Strip the class rather than removing the node: the element
                    // may be a wrapper we don't own, and an unclassed empty div
                    // is harmless. Dropping the id also clears the duplicate-id
                    // collision that comes with the repeated markup.
                    matches[i].classList.remove(cls)
                    matches[i].removeAttribute('id')
                    matches[i].setAttribute('data-zephr-duplicate', 'true')
                  }
                })
              }

              const runZephr = (attempt = 0) => {
                const available = typeof window.zephrBrowser !== 'undefined'
                console.log(`${LOG} attempt=${attempt} available=${available}`)

                if (!available) {
                  if (attempt < 3) {
                    setTimeout(() => runZephr(attempt + 1), 250)
                  } else {
                    console.warn(`${LOG} zephrBrowser not available after ${attempt + 1} attempts`)
                  }
                  return
                }

                try {window.zephrBrowser.run()} catch (e) {

        apply(root)

      var found = root.querySelectorAll('.PollResultsTab-infoBox-container')
